research.title: Support Request Classification with Sparse Text Features
bullets: Prepared labeled support requests by normalizing text, removing duplicate messages, and checking category consistency under an established annotation guide.
Implemented TF-IDF and logistic regression baselines using predefined data splits, then summarized classification errors across overlapping request categories.

research.title: Sentence Retrieval for Policy Question Answering
bullets: Segmented policy documents into candidate sentences and organized annotated question–sentence pairs into the prescribed training and evaluation partitions.
Implemented a TF-IDF cosine similarity retrieval baseline and reviewed missed matches involving paraphrases, abbreviations, and questions requiring surrounding context.

projects.title: Character N-Gram Baselines for Language Identification
bullets: Prepared a labeled short-text dataset with consistent Unicode normalization and stratified splits for evaluating language identification on brief inputs.
Implemented character n-gram features with multinomial naive Bayes, comparing confusion patterns for closely related languages and texts containing borrowed words.

projects.title: Extractive Summarization with Sentence Similarity
bullets: Implemented a centroid-based summarization baseline that ranked article sentences by TF-IDF similarity and selected sentences under a fixed length constraint.
Compared selected sentences against reference summaries using unigram overlap, and inspected examples for redundant content and missing central information.
